candidate_workaround: Parse the validation receipt and grant runner credit only when its explicit valid field is true.
failure_signature: Runner-use accounting treats the existence of a failed validation receipt as a successful invocation witness.
recurrence_guard: Never infer a passing runner from file existence; parse the declared success field and fail closed on malformed or absent receipts.
rollback: Keep runner invocation credit false until an explicit valid receipt exists.
scope_boundary: Runner accounting only; a valid receipt remains bounded same-owner evidence.
title: Explicit-valid gate for validation-runner credit
trigger_preconditions: A generated portfolio grants invocation credit from a validation receipt.
